title: billofmaterials - Games ROM Library
description: Schema for B.O.M. Games ROM Libraries: where the ROMs come from and go, and the default options of its romsets

datpack.description: Glob of the DAT pack zip, or globs of several packs; the newest match of each glob by the (YYYY-MM-DD) in its name wins, and a DAT is read from the first pack that holds it

oneOf.description: Glob of the DAT pack zip

items.description: Glob of a DAT pack zip

oneOf.description: Globs of the DAT pack zips, in order of preference (a parent/clone pack first)

sourceRoot.description: Absolute folder holding the seeded fullsets

outputRoot.description: Absolute folder where the library is built

retroarchPlaylistPath.description: Absolute folder where the RetroArch playlists are written

defaults.description: Default options of every romset of the library

options.description: Options shared by the library defaults, a romset and a DAT; a more specific level overrides a broader one, lists replace

mode.description: How files reach the library: hardlink or symlink (igir link) or copy

preferRegion.description: Regions in order of preference when keeping a single release per game

preferLanguage.description: Languages in order of preference when keeping a single release per game

filterLanguage.description: Only keep releases in one of these languages

onlyRetail.description: Keep only retail releases (no demo, beta, prototype, aftermarket...)

bios.description: Keep BIOS files; false drops them

enabled.description: False freezes it: never synced, never pruned
